answer: Vine distance bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a vine entry. A newcomer must forge three mutual links within 3 links of a seed, each a 15-credit filing. Each epoch, auditors wander the vine from seeds; identities past 3 links burn the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 115,000 credits against a 40,000 pool; a rented-link ring fails when a wander finds undefended links. An honest agent pays 45 to forge three links once, then recovers the bond.
